snippet.title: Rhythm Heaven Groove – Overview Trailer – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Rhythm Heaven Groove launches for Nintendo Switch on July 2, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/rhythm-heaven-groove-switch/

Take on over 80 games & challenge your rhythm in single player or play with up to four friends & get in the groove with over 30 co-op & competitive rhythm games.

#RhythmHeavenGroove #NintendoSwitch

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
